my_pr.title: fix(server): Codex shadow homes keep SQLite state in the shared home
my_pr.text: If you run two Codex accounts in T3 Code, newer Codex builds eventually knock the second one offline with a 'not a symlink' error. This keeps both accounts on the same Codex databases. Fixes #5817. It overlaps #19861, opened earlier with the same approach: #19861 stops for manual recovery when old SQLite links exist, while this one removes them automatically. Maintainers can pick either.

merge_first.title: fix(server): removing a worktree on Windows no longer deletes what its junctions point to
merge_first.today: Removing a worktree on Windows can delete the real folders its junctions point to. Fixes #14990. It replaces #15833 and #17076.

merge_first.title: fix(web): offline launch no longer deletes T3 Connect environments
merge_first.today: Open the app offline and Clerk loads as signed out, so T3 Code deletes the saved T3 Connect environments. Fixes #17917 by changing one condition.

merge_first.title: fix(server): retried Codex rewinds no longer delete extra turns
merge_first.today: When a rewind half-fails and is retried, Codex reverts extra turns and deletes history the user meant to keep. The fix tracks native turn IDs instead of a count.

merge_first.title: fix(server): atomic writes keep the file's permission bits
merge_first.today: Every atomic save resets the file mode, so a `settings.json` locked to 0600 comes back 0644. That file can hold an OpenCode server password or an Antigravity API key. Fixes #14967.

merge_first.title: fix(desktop): built-in browser sites can no longer post notifications without permission
merge_first.today: Every site opened in the built-in browser silently gets notification permission and can raise native notifications under T3 Code's name. Fixes #20218.

merge_first.title: fix(claude): Plan mode asks before writes in Auto and Full access
merge_first.today: With Plan mode on in Auto or Full access, Claude's edits and file-changing shell commands run without a prompt. Fixes #15503.

merge_first.title: fix(opencode): reapply permission rules on resume
merge_first.today: After the OpenCode server restarts, resumed threads drop their permission rules, so a Full access thread starts asking for file reads again.

merge_first.title: fix(server): release Codex sessions when the app-server dies
merge_first.today: When the shared Codex app-server dies, every Codex thread stays broken until T3 Code restarts. Fixes #16502. A maintainer already closed #20301 as covered by this PR, and #20992 and #21013 are the same fix again.

pick_one.name: Codex app-server crash
pick_one.text: Three authors wired the same termination signal into the same Codex event queue. #18764 goes further and also handles an app-server that stops answering.

pick_one.name: Claude Stop hangs
pick_one.text: #21303 adds the same 10 second timeout to the same interrupt call as #16419, plus a warning log.

pick_one.name: Windows worktree junctions
pick_one.text: #21099 says it replaces the other two.

pick_one.name: Automatic messages refused between turns
pick_one.text: Both change the same condition in `CommandPolicy.ts` in 8 or 9 lines for #15600.

pick_one.name: Old messages flash during thread switches
pick_one.text: Two authors removed the same 98 lines from the chat view.

take_over.title: settle the OpenCode model catalog before caching it
take_over.text: Saved OpenCode models show as Unavailable after startup (#15994, #15155). The loader it fixes moved to `packages/provider-opencode/src/server/status.ts` with the same bug intact. The newer #21100 is larger.

take_over.title: Claude Auto mode asks before commands it escalates
take_over.text: In Auto mode, commands your `permissions.ask` rules or hooks escalate, such as `git push`, run without a prompt (#15353).

take_over.title: PR code tab no longer reloads on background refreshes
take_over.text: Matches #14483, one of the most upvoted open issues. #13835 overlaps it.
